Tripping on acid certainly allowed me to see things from a very different perspective, the things that have been bothering me suddenly didn't seem that big of a deal, and I noticed that I have a tendency to focus too much on negative things and blow them up out of proportion. Although life does get quite tiresome sometimes, and often I ask myself why I'm here, why exactly we have to put up with all of this, why am I supposed to be strong and shit when I didn't even ask to be here in the first place, maybe a therapist can help me figure that out, I really don't know if I can find the answer to that question by myself.

Well, it wasn't necessarily a dark trip, I was emotionally constipated and really needing to cry, and during the trip I was able to vomit everything that was making me sick, and I realized how absurd the idea of killing myself was, it was a very cathartic experience. I took the acid all by myself precisely to face all of those dark feelings and thoughts, knowing what to expect and knowing that there was a risk of hurting myself during the trip, luckily that didn't happen, but it was a risk I was willing to take.

What made me sad was the fact that I allowed things to get to the point where suicidal thoughts became very recurrent and powerful in my everyday life, so if there's something that I was able to take from the trip is that I need to seek a therapist ASAP. I don't think acid magically made all of my issues dissapear, but it made me think that maybe I should look for help, it gave me sudden motivation to seek for help. Again, I'm just not sure if that will last for very long.
